intro: The workshop handles routine service, diagnostics and pre-route inspections. We work on the machines people actually ride here, which means commuters and working bikes as readily as touring machines.
handles: Chain, sprocket, brake and tyre work
Suspension service and setup for load
Fault finding on machines that other workshops have already looked at
not_handled: Engine rebuilds and machining, which we refer out

services.name: Routine service
services.summary: Oil, filters, chain, brakes, tyres and fasteners against an interval adjusted for how the bike is actually used.
services.output: Written record of what was done and what was measured

services.name: Pre-route inspection
services.summary: A structured check before a long ride, aimed at finding what would strand you rather than what would annoy you.
services.output: Pass, watch, or fix list with reasoning

services.name: Pre-purchase inspection
services.summary: An independent inspection of a bike you are considering, with the faults named plainly and the cost to correct them estimated.
services.output: Condition report and cost to correct

services.name: Diagnostic session
services.summary: For an intermittent fault that has already resisted one attempt. Booked as time rather than as a fixed job.
services.output: Findings, including where we did not find it

services.name: Suspension setup
services.summary: Sag and damping set for your weight, your luggage and the surface you actually ride on.
services.output: Recorded settings you can return to

services.name: Wet season preparation
services.summary: Tyres, brakes, visibility, electrical sealing and chain protection ahead of the long rains.

practical.v: Labour by time, parts at cost plus a stated margin. You are called before the estimate is exceeded.
We will fit parts you supply, and we will tell you plainly if we think they are the wrong ones.
If we cannot find a fault we say so and charge for the time, not for a guess fitted as a repair.
Every job leaves with a written record of what was measured, not just what was replaced.
Short jobs can be waited for. Anything over two hours is better dropped off.
We road test after any brake, tyre, chain or suspension work, and we tell you if we did not.
